content:
mira: Heads-up — small RFC follow-up idea: split the routing decision into two phases: (1) penalty calculator (stateless, per-request) and (2) weight combiner (stateful, tenant/global). Goal is to make region/tier/latency penalties pluggable without changing the runtime.
devon: Can you sketch the API surface? also curious about cache and keying implications.
mira: Quick sketch:
```json
{
  \"penalty_vector\": { \"region_penalty\": 0.2, \"latency_penalty\": 0.05, \"cost_penalty\": 0.1 },
  \"candidates\": [ { \"route\": \"edge-us-west-1\", \"base_score\": 0.75 }, ... ]
}
```
Then weight combiner takes penalty_vector + candidate list + tenant profile -> returns ordered weights.
sam: That looks promising. Downsides: we push more bytes in the control plane (penalty_vector + serialized state) but we can cache penalty results for short TTLs.
alex: How does this change fallback behaviour? we need deterministic tie-breakers otherwise canaries might flip-flop.
mira: Runtime stays the same for fallback: it consumes the ordered weights and tries first available. The difference is the ordering is now explicit and derived by the combiner. For rollouts we keep a compatibility flag so runtime can fall back to the single-step eval if something goes wrong.
ops-bot: Perf-sim: staging synthetic run (10k evals) -> avg eval CPU down ~5%, median eval latency down ~3%, network event size +1.8% from penalty vector telemetry. (job: route-sim-2026-03-20)
devon: Config surface concern: we can't expose a million knobs. Proposal: 3 fixed plugin hooks (region, latency, cost) with a simple schema and a compatibility version. Also we must emit per-step timers: penalty.calc.ms and combiner.ms.
sam: Agree on timers. Also: prefix-caching interaction — penalty calc must be deterministic for identical prefix hashes, otherwise cache hit rate drops. Suggest we define the penalty input canonicalization: (user_tier, region_hint, seq_hash).
mira: Next steps: I'll open an RFC draft with the API prototype and a tiny prototype in the policy sandbox. Action items: mira -> RFC + example; devon -> schema + metric names; sam -> prototype serializer and cache test. Target: canary in 2 sprints if prototype looks clean. :thumbsup:
alex: ack. happy to help with rollout checklist and canary dashboards.
mira: thanks — i'll ping when the draft PR is up.
